principle: No single bug, data fault, broker fault, node fault or infrastructure failure may create uncontrolled portfolio exposure. Uncertain state fails closed: NO_NEW_RISK.

separation_of_authority.market_execution_engine: Generates and manages market opportunities subject to safety authority.
separation_of_authority.risk_guardian: Independent process using broker/account truth; may override, restrict, reduce or stop execution regardless of strategy conviction.

circuit_breaker_levels.1_WARNING: Abnormal condition; alert and restrict only unsafe actions.
circuit_breaker_levels.2_RESTRICTED: No new campaigns; existing campaigns may be managed defensively.
circuit_breaker_levels.3_SAFE_MODE: No new orders or add-ons; protect/reduce existing risk using deterministic emergency policy.
circuit_breaker_levels.4_EMERGENCY_STOP: Cancel eligible pending orders, block all new execution and reduce/close positions according to emergency policy.
circuit_breaker_levels.5_FULL_ISOLATION: Disconnect affected node/broker/strategy or entire system until reconciliation proves safe restart.

restart_rule: Restart is prohibited until broker/account/position/order/campaign/contract/data/risk state is independently reconciled and the triggering fault is cleared or explicitly quarantined.
governance: This contract is a production eligibility requirement. It does not alter historical alpha selection, R5.4 control logic or R5.5 research outcomes.
